Command.Statement: WITH MEMBER [Measures].[Leaf] AS IIf([ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Children.Count = 0, "leaf", "node") MEMBER [Measures].[Ordinal] AS [ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].CurrentMember.Level.Ordinal SELECT {[Measures].[Leaf], [Measures].[Ordinal]} ON 0, {[ZCLDIAG.ZCLDIAG_ICD].Members} ON 1 FROM [ZCLHIER]
